system: Breakout+ER buy stop at prior HHV20 (prior ER20>=.3), fade2 Close->next Open, SMA30, no market gate
conditions: breadth_sempit: <40% stocks above SMA50; trend_bear: equal-weight proxy below SMA200; labels from previous Close.
actions: block_entry: no new entries; half_size: new entries 5% equity; derisk_exit: sell all at Open AND block entries; llv10_stop: intraday LLV10 sell stop active only in condition.
selection: Train spread: CAGR > base AND records >= base; max CAGR. Frozen before evaluation. All configs also run on later windows and reported as post-freeze diagnostics.
caution: Conditions chosen after viewing full-history attribution (analyze_market_conditions.py) -> look-ahead in hypothesis selection; validation/test not independent.
